boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations around the Davis Square, College Avenue, Elm Street, and Highland Avenue corridors just off the Tufts orbit.

cards.title: Somerville Theatre — movie programming
cards.subtitle: Davis Square corridor
cards.notes: Check the current movie listings, then use the theatre’s address page to confirm the Davis Square entrance before you head over.
cards.short_summary: A historic Davis Square theatre with current movie programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Somerville Theatre lists its address as 55 Davis Square and directs visitors to movie times to determine theatre hours.
cards.access_notes: Ticketed programming; consult the current movie-times page before visiting.

cards.title: Diesel Cafe — daytime café stop
cards.subtitle: Elm Street corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Use the posted daily 7 a.m.–7 p.m. schedule for a coffee, tea, or food stop at 257 Elm Street.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Square café with daily posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Diesel Cafe identifies its location as 257 Elm Street in Somerville and lists daily hours of 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7 a.m.–7 p.m. per the business’s website.

cards.title: Mr. Crêpe — sweet or savory crêpes
cards.subtitle: Davis Square corridor
cards.notes: Pick a sweet or savory crêpe at 51 Davis Square; the menu also notes a gluten-free buckwheat option on request.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Square crêperie and café with sweet and savory options.
cards.evidence_claim: Mr. Crêpe identifies itself as a Davis Square crêperie and café at 51 Davis Square, serving sweet and savory crêpes.
cards.access_notes: The business posts Davis Square hours; confirm updates before visiting.

cards.title: Comicazi — comics and tabletop games
cards.subtitle: Highland Avenue corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Browse comics, games, toys, and tabletop items at 407 Highland Avenue, then check the calendar if you want a scheduled game event.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Square shop for comics, collectibles, and tabletop games.
cards.evidence_claim: Comicazi lists comics, games, toys, and more at 407 Highland Avenue near Davis Square MBTA Station.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: J.P. Licks — ice cream, yogurt, and coffee
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Use the Davis Square location page to check the day’s closing time before stopping at 4A College Avenue for ice cream, yogurt, or coffee.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue location serving ice cream, yogurt, and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: J.P. Licks lists its Davis Square location at 4A College Avenue and identifies the business as ice cream, yogurt, and coffee.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists daily hours, including later Friday and Saturday closing times.

cards.title: Nine Bar Espresso — Gracenote coffee
cards.subtitle: Holland Street corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Order a coffee or tea at 11 Holland Street; the café’s site identifies Gracenote Coffee Roasters and daily pastries from A&J King.
cards.short_summary: A compact Davis Square espresso bar with coffee, tea, and pastries.
cards.evidence_claim: Nine Bar Espresso lists 11 Holland Street in Davis Square and says it serves Gracenote coffee, tea, and daily A&J King pastries.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are daily, 8 a.m.–3 p.m.

cards.title: Somerville Community Path — shared path connection
cards.subtitle: Community Path corridor at Davis Square
cards.notes: Enter from the Davis Square side for a walk, run, or bike connection; follow posted detours and temporary-access notices on the city page.
cards.short_summary: A city-operated multi-use path connected to Davis Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Somerville describes the historic Community Path between Davis Square and Lowell Street and its operation and maintenance framework.
cards.source_title: City of Somerville — Green Line and Community Path Extension
cards.access_notes: Use only open path sections and observe any city-posted detours or construction notices.

cards.title: Statue Park — Elm Street public-space stop
cards.subtitle: Elm Street corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Pause at Statue Park while walking Elm Street and use the surrounding sidewalks and crossings completed by the city to continue through Davis Square.
cards.short_summary: A named public-space landmark within Davis Square’s pedestrian network.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Somerville identifies Statue Park in Davis Square and reports completed sidewalks along Elm Street and around the park.
cards.source_title: City of Somerville — Safety and Accessibility Improvements in Davis Sq.
cards.access_notes: An outdoor public-space stop; follow current street and construction conditions.

cards.title: Davis Square Farmers Market — local-produce market
cards.subtitle: Herbert and Day streets corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Look for the market in the Herbert and Day streets parking lot on its scheduled Wednesday session, and confirm the seasonal schedule before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A City of Somerville farmers-market location in Davis Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Somerville identifies the Davis Square Farmers Market location as the parking lot at Herbert and Day streets and lists Wednesday noon–6 p.m. sessions.
cards.source_title: City of Somerville — Mobile Farmers Market announcement
cards.access_notes: This is a scheduled market; verify the current season, date, and vendor availability before visiting.

cards.title: Davis Square Station — Red Line access
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor, Davis Square
cards.notes: Use the station as a transit anchor for the Davis Square corridor, then check MBTA service alerts and accessibility details before starting your trip.
cards.short_summary: The Davis Square transit stop at the center of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Somerville identifies Davis Square station on College Avenue in its Davis Square mobility and accessibility improvement work.
cards.source_title: City of Somerville — Safety and Accessibility Improvements in Davis Sq.
cards.access_notes: Check the MBTA for current service, elevator, and alert information before travel.
